description: Where a build started with create_api or request_endpoint is: its phase, each endpoint with its test results or what went wrong, and what the build said last. A finished build is not public until it is published (publish_request, or the owner in the dashboard). Pass `wait_seconds` (up to 50) and the call returns as soon as something changes, so you can follow a build without sleeping. With the shared demo key it reports the plain build status only.

request_id.description: The request_id create_api or request_endpoint returned.

wait_seconds.description: Hold the call up to this many seconds (max 50) until the build's state changes.

name: get_build_status
title: Check a maviapi build
